Data Breach Response Planner v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Data Breach Response Planner API.
- Generates tailored data breach response playbooks based on organizational assessment data.
- Includes endpoints for health checks, plan generation, incident response phase reference, and tool recommendations.
- Supports compliance requirements and integration with existing security tools.
- Offers clear pricing tiers for organizations of all sizes.
